ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A platform A with mass $m=100\mathrm{g}$ is connected to the upper end of a spring with stiffness coefficient $k=200\mathrm{N}/\mathrm{m}$. The lower end of the spring is fixed to the ground, forming a vertical spring oscillator. A block B with the same mass $m$ is placed on top of A, causing A and B to oscillate together vertically. The natural length of the spring is $5\mathrm{cm}$, and the thickness of A is negligible. The gravitational acceleration $g$ is taken as $10\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$.

1. Find the height of the equilibrium position from the ground.
2. When the amplitude is $0.5\mathrm{cm}$, find the maximum supporting force of A on B.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A platform A with mass $m=100\mathrm{g}$ is connected to the upper end of a spring with stiffness coefficient $k=200\mathrm{N}/\mathrm{m}$. The lower end of the spring is fixed to the ground, forming a vertical spring oscillator. A block B with the same mass $m$ is placed on top of A, causing A and B to oscillate together vertically. The natural length of the spring is $5\mathrm{cm}$, and the thickness of A is negligible. The gravitational acceleration $g$ is taken as $10\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$. 1. Find the height of the equilibrium position from the ground. 2. When the amplitude is $0.5\mathrm{cm}$, find the maximum supporting force of A on B.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The attached diagram shows a block labeled B resting on a thin horizontal platform labeled A. Platform A is attached to the upper end of a vertical coil spring, and the lower end of the spring is fixed at the ground/base labeled C. This matches a vertical spring oscillator with B sitting on A. Reasoning: Each body has mass m=100 g=0.100 kg, so the total oscillating mass of A and B together is 2m=0.200 kg. At equilibrium, the upward spring force balances the total weight: kx=(2m)g. Thus x=(0.200×10)/200=0.010 m=1 cm. The spring natural length is 5 cm, so the equilibrium height above the ground is 5 cm−1 cm=4 cm. For the support force on B, the combined oscillator has angular frequency squared ω²=k/(2m)=200/0.200=1000 s⁻². With amplitude 0.5 cm=0.005 m, the maximum upward acceleration occurs at the lowest point and is a_max=ω²A=1000×0.005=5 m/s². For block B alone, N−mg=ma_max, so N_max=m(g+a_max)=0.100×(10+5)=1.5 N.
